author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Diagonal broom as in the reference: straight handle to the top-right corner, domed ferrule with a band perpendicular to the handle, three fanned bristle strands whose outer strands continue the ferrule sides tangentially. No useful Lucide broom construction (Lucide brush differs); cubic construction on a (2,-3) axis.
omissions: Handle drawn as a single stroke instead of a tube with a round cap; four bristles reduced to three (8-unit spacing); the closed ribbon of the outer-left bristle drawn as a single strand.
